pages.text: Coal and hydrogen under pressure make $(fluid)Synthetic Crude$() (Bergius) - the pack's crude oil will do as well. In the $(item)Cracking Tower$() its long chains break into short ones: hotter gives more $(fluid)Ethylene$() (about 1100 K), cooler more $(fluid)Propylene$() (1000 K). Each needs a 60% share. Above 1150 K coke fouls the Zeolite Catalyst; steam keeps it down.
